status: frozen before any holdout model calls
purpose: Select a documentation candidate for full n=100 validation without reusing outcome-selected discovery queries.

rationale.H12: Tests composition of H1 and H2 without H3.
rationale.H123: Retained as a secondary damage/control arm because H3 did not beat its shuffled-port control on the discovery panel.
rationale.discovery_panel: May be used for mechanism diagnosis only, never for candidate selection.

composition_gate.H12_cp: at least max(H1, H2) - 1 query in each model
composition_gate.interpretation: Failure rejects the composability claim but does not reject an independently promoted H1 or H2.

candidate_ranking: maximize the smaller model-specific paired net versus DRAFT
maximize summed paired net versus DRAFT
stop_rule: If no primary candidate passes, do not spend on a full variant run; redesign the documentation hypothesis. CurrentNot full validation is reported separately and cannot promote H1/H2/H12.
